newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks jump at market open, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks jump at market open, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. stocks rushed higher at the market open on Friday, with both the Dow industrials and technology stocks bouncing back after yesterday's declines.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was trading up around 64 points at 7718. Its swift rise prompted the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index-trading eight minutes after the market open.
The Nasdaq composite rose around eight points to 1444.
"It's just more whipsawing," Harry Laubscher, a market analyst at Tucker Anthony, said.
The long bond, recently weak, was up 4/32 at 6.77 percent.
